title: Share data files on the team drive
body:
- Put `krillcast_merged.csv`, `CCAMLR_MPA.json` and the regridded CMIP6 file in one folder on the team Google Drive.
- Compute a SHA-256 checksum for each (`sha256sum`, or `certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256` on Windows).
- Add the folder link and checksums to `data/README.md`.
- Ask one Analysis member to follow the README from scratch and confirm the checksums match.

**Done when:** merged and verified by one other person.

_Planned for week 1._

title: Get the benchmark running on PACE
body:
- Start from `jobs/benchmark.sbatch` (already written): check the partition and time limits for our allocation, then add `--seed` once the Analysis task lands.
- Submit it once on PACE and note run time and queue wait.

**Done when:** one `sbatch` command produces `benchmark_table.csv` in a dated folder, and the run time is posted in the team channel.

_Planned for week 2._

title: Rebuild the training data with the longitude fix
body:
The current `krillcast_merged.csv` matched 77% of hauls to the wrong climate grid column (see `docs/CHANGES_preprocessing_v2.md`). The pipeline in `scripts/data/` fixes this.

- Download the historical CMIP6 fields for MPI-ESM1-2-LR with `scripts/data/download_cmip6.py` (on PACE).
- Regrid with `scripts/data/build_climate_grid.py`, then build `data/krillcast_merged.csv` with `scripts/data/build_dataset.py`.
- Put the new file on the shared drive and update its checksum in `data/README.md`.
- Rerun `jobs/benchmark.sbatch` and post the new table.

**Done when:** the rebuilt file is shared and the new benchmark table is posted.

_Planned for week 2._

title: Add a --seed option to training
body:
Two runs with the same settings currently give different results, so we can't tell a real improvement from noise.

- Add `--seed` to `scripts/train_fishcast.py`; seed Python, NumPy and PyTorch before the data loads.
- Save the seed in `metrics.json` under `config`.
- Add a test: two one-epoch runs with the same seed on the synthetic data give identical `test_metrics`.

**Done when:** merged and the test passes in CI.

Files: `scripts/train_fishcast.py`, `fishcast/config.py`, `tests/`

_Planned for week 1._

title: Why does the climate-only GP rank hotspots backwards?
body:
Its test ROC-AUC is about 0.35, so it ranks ordinary hauls above hotspots more often than chance.

- Train `climate_conditioned_gp` for 20 epochs and check the sign of `hotspot_scale` in `final_gp_diagnostics`.
- Compare predicted hotspot probability with the observed hotspot rate per 5° sector in the test years.
- Check whether 1 minus the probability gives an AUC near 0.65; if so, find where the sign is lost.

**Done when:** a write-up in `analysis/experiments/` with the likely cause, or the causes ruled out.

_Planned for week 1._

title: South-polar projection prototype
body:
A working starter is in `viz/prototype/polar_map.html` (land, MPAs and 500 hauls in a south-polar projection). Run it with `python -m http.server` from the repo root.

- Compare `d3.geoAzimuthalEqualArea` and `d3.geoStereographic` and pick one, with a sentence on why.
- Add CCAMLR management subarea boundaries (48.1, 48.2, 48.3).
- Add a control for sample size and a colour legend with real numbers.

**Done when:** merged, with hauls near 180 degrees drawn in the right place.
